pattern: に至るまで（にいたるまで）
purpose: Include even the farthest or smallest endpoint of a range.
keywords: I do everything myself, from design through packaging.
It is carefully drawn down to the finest detail.
Even the staff’s clothing is coordinated.
restrictions: Often with から to frame a broad range.
mistake: It marks inclusive extent, not merely a destination.

segments.role: Include even the farthest or smallest endpoint of a range. N + に至るまで
